moments.label: Game opens with 'DRAG TO MOVE - DEFEND THE FORT' prompt and a tutorial hand pulsing on the virtual joystick next to a 270-gold pad.
Player drags the joystick to move the cowboy onto the glowing 270-gold pad and pauses briefly.
Gold counts down from 270 to 0, triggering a giant pickaxe and gold-filled minecart animation to build the Gold Mine.
Minecart rolls out onto the tracks as the tutorial hand points to a pile of gold bars to the left.
Cowboy walks over the gold pile, collecting 80 gold before exploring toward the bottom-left.
Cutscene camera pans to a rock cave entrance as armed outlaws emerge to raid the town.
Camera returns to town with a 'GET CLOSE TO SHOOT THE OUTLAWS' banner as the cowboy moves toward the fence.
Cowboy auto-shoots the first wave of outlaws at the fence, eliminating them and collecting gold up to 207.
Cowboy fights off another group of outlaws including a heavy enemy while a new 200-gold pad spawns in smoke.
Cowboy guns down a cluster of outlaws outside the fence, raising his gold from 255 to 327.
Outlaws attack the wooden fence while the cowboy holds position near the 200-gold pad and fires.
Cowboy steps onto the 200-gold pad, triggering a giant glowing whiskey glass animation that unlocks 'DEPUTIES'.
Camera pans right to reveal a new watchtower and a 400-gold pad spawning in smoke before returning to the cowboy at a 1,050-gold pad.
Cowboy and newly spawned deputies team up to mow down a dense line of outlaws pouring from the cave, boosting gold to 350.
The town fence glows green and upgrades with sparkles while deputies hold the line against the outlaw wave.
Cowboy collects a large burst of gold from the minecart, jumping from 392 to 704 gold while deputies fight at the gate.
Cowboy lingers near the 300-gold pad with over 700 gold while deputies continue defending the fence.

game.title: Wild West
game.objective: Defend the Wild West town from waves of outlaws while collecting gold to build mines, hire deputies, and upgrade defenses.
game.controls: Drag a virtual joystick anywhere on screen to move the cowboy; shooting outlaws in range and spending gold on pads happen automatically.
game.core_loop: Move near outlaws to auto-shoot them, collect dropped gold and minecart payouts, and step onto glowing pads to build or upgrade town defenses.
features: Virtual joystick movement with auto-aim shooting
Gold Mine construction and passive minecart gold delivery
Escalating outlaw waves with heavy enemies
game.progression: Outlaw waves grow larger and include tougher heavy enemies, while build pad costs scale up from 200-270 gold to 300, 400, and 1,050 gold as new areas and upgrades unlock.
game.hook_idea: At t=63.0s, a giant glowing whiskey glass slams down and shatters into 'DEPUTIES' while the cowboy blasts a swarming wave of outlaws at the fence.
